question.problem: Compute $\textrm E[5X-2Y]$ if $\textrm E[X]=1$ and $\textrm E[Y] = 2.$
question.worked_solution:
For any random variables $X,Y$ and any constants $a,b,$ we have

$$
\textrm E[aX+bY] = a \textrm E[X] + b \textrm E[Y].
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[5X-2Y] & =5\text{E}[X]-2\text{E}[Y] \\  & =5(1)-2(2) \\  & =1.\end{aligned}
$$
